visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: With competing factions clashing over the ultimate fate of human existence, what choice can a fractured mind make under siege?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: As SEELE launches an all-out assault on NERV to eliminate the Evas before Gendo can trigger the Human Instrumentality Project, a shattered Shinji is pushed to his absolute brink with humanity's fate in his hands.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Heavy, immersive, and fast-paced; a solitary apocalyptic drama defined by urgent action and psychological tension.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Directed by Hideaki Anno and Kazuya Tsurumaki, this relentless 87-minute animated drama fuses intense sci-fi combat with an unsparing, high-stakes psychological breakdown.
